about_assistant.answer: I'm AdilChat, an AI assistant created by Adil Saeed to share information about his education, skills, projects, experience, and how to get in touch with him.

professional_summary.answer: Adil Saeed is a Software Engineering undergraduate at IMSciences, Peshawar (GPA 3.67), focused on AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Computer Vision. He completed the GIKI Full Stack AI Bootcamp, multiple DeepLearning.AI courses by Andrew Ng, and leads AI/ML initiatives as a Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador.

skills_programming.answer: Adil's core programming languages are Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, and MySQL.

skills_ai_ml.answer: Adil's AI/ML skill set covers Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, and Large Language Models, using Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.

skills_tools.answer: Adil's toolset includes Git/GitHub, Jupyter Notebook, VS Code, OpenCV, FAISS, HuggingFace, and Gradio, alongside Google Cloud Platform fundamentals.

education_current.answer: Adil is pursuing a BASc in Computer Software Engineering at IMSciences, Peshawar (September 2023 – September 2027), with a 3.67 GPA, specializing in Web Development, Machine Learning, Software Architecture, and System Design.

education_earlier.answer: Before university, Adil completed a Diploma in Information Technology from Mandani Institute, HSSC (Pre-Medical) from Islamia College Peshawar, and SSC (Pre-Medical) from New Islamia School and College, Charsadda — all with Grade A.

bootcamp.answer: Adil completed the GIKI ML → LLM Bootcamp 2025 (July 2025), a 4-week intensive program covering Machine Learning, Deep Learning, CNNs, RNNs, Computer Vision, NLP, LLMs, and MLOps.

projects_overview.answer: Adil's key projects include a Multilingual RAG Chatbot for GIKI, a Sentiment Analysis System (85% precision), a Heart Disease Prediction model (90% recall), a Face Recognition app, a Login Risk Detection model, and an OCR Text Recognition system.

project_rag_chatbot.answer: Adil built a Multilingual RAG Chatbot (English/Urdu) for GIKI's prospectus queries, using Python, FAISS vector search, HuggingFace embeddings, and a Gradio interface, developed during his GIKI internship.

project_sentiment.answer: Adil built a Sentiment Analysis System using Python, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF, and Logistic Regression, achieving 85% precision in classifying text sentiment.

project_face_recognition.answer: Adil developed a real-time Face Recognition application using Python, OpenCV, and Convolutional Neural Networks, improving accuracy through transfer learning.

project_heart_disease.answer: Adil built CardioDiagnosis, a heart disease prediction model using Random Forest and SVM, achieving 90% recall for cardiovascular risk assessment, validated with ROC curves and cross-validation.

project_login_risk.answer: Adil built a Login Risk Detection model using RandomForestClassifier and anomaly detection to identify suspicious login patterns in real time.

project_ocr.answer: Adil developed an OCR Text Recognition system using Python, Tesseract OCR, and OpenCV, supporting PNG, JPEG, JPG, BMP, and DOCX formats with direct copy/export functionality.

project_other.answer: Other projects include a Crop Yield Prediction pipeline using regression models for agricultural forecasting, and a Student Attendance Management System built with MySQL.

experience_overview.answer: Adil's experience includes a Project Internship at GIKI (Summer 2025), the role of AI/ML Lead at Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors (2024–present), and Technical Team Member at MLSA Peshawar.

experience_giki.answer: As a Project Intern at GIKI (Summer 2025), Adil developed a RAG Chatbot for prospectus queries, applying ML in NLP and vector search alongside hands-on AI research experience.

experience_mlsa.answer: As AI/ML Lead for Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors (2024–present), Adil has led technical workshops on ML/DL/NLP for 50+ students, mentoring peers in ethical, scalable AI applications.

experience_ambassador.answer: Adil served as Ambassador for the Digital Architect Conference 2025, representing IMSciences at a six-day international event and moderating sessions on AI and digital transformation.

certifications.answer: Adil holds the GIKI Full Stack AI Bootcamp certificate, three DeepLearning.AI (Coursera) specializations by Andrew Ng, GCP Fundamentals from SimpleLearn, and the Digital Architect Conference Ambassador certificate from IEC.

achievements.answer: Adil's key achievements include selection for the Prime Minister's Laptop Scheme (First Merit List), a 3.67 GPA in Software Engineering, and leading AI/ML workshops for 50+ students as a Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador.

career_goals.answer: Adil plans to pursue an MS in AI/ML research, and is currently mastering LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agentic AI workflows, and cloud deployment on platforms like Vercel, Render, and Pinecone.

mentors_family.answer: Adil is mentored by his elder brother Asad Ali, a Software Engineer, and finds his primary AI inspiration in Sir Ali Imran Sindhu at GIKI, who guided his bootcamp participation and research direction.

soft_skills.answer: Adil's soft skills include leadership (as AI/ML Lead and Ambassador), effective communication through session moderation and mentoring, problem-solving in real-world AI applications, and strong time management.

languages.answer: Adil is fluent in English (professional/academic), native in Urdu, and proficient in Pashto — relevant to his research interest in low-resource language NLP.

availability.answer: Adil is open to AI/ML internships, freelance projects, research collaborations, open-source contributions, and junior AI engineer roles — remote or onsite — particularly in RAG systems, LLM fine-tuning, and low-resource NLP.

location.answer: Adil is based in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan (PKT, UTC+5).

values.answer: Adil believes in focused excellence — 'Focus means saying no to many good opportunities to say yes to a few great ones' — along with consistency, ethical AI development, and using technology for social good in Pakistan.
